arm_meanings.P: same federation with specified protected aggregation/release
arm_meanings.Z: P with the specified genuine proof policy

primary_contrast: MSE(source-diversity1)-MSE(source-diversity4), at matched consumed count and label quality; no proof-only quality benefit is inferred.
falsification_rule: Proposed minimum useful scoped diversity gain0.01 MSE. CI upper bound below0.01 refutes that minimum-gain hypothesis; overlapping interval or underpower is inconclusive. Freeze before executing, retain adverse results.
missing_failure_policy: Retain every seed/attempt, failure, timeout, cost and missing pair. Do not impute missing quality as zero or condition the deployment primary comparison on completers.
non_iid_control: Freeze source-distribution generator, global task mixture and skew strength; verify realized distributions and label reliability, rather than assuming factor labels imply independent contrasts.
inference: Paired independent seeds, source/group variation and held-out populations; fixed analysis before runs. Same-record F/P/Z honest traces must agree when mechanisms/rounding are identical.
